a team without a sngle 50-run stand. Karunaratne the only player to get past 40 today, 
and he did it with some force at the end. But it also tells the story - Sri Lanka looked in 
control for certain periods, and suddenly they weren't anymore. Starts all the way from 
the start up to the lower middle order. No one managing to stamp their authority for a 
long enough time, and maybe that's the difference between 280-plus and 262. Still, it's 
never an easy chase. There is some assistance in this pitch for the spinners. Whether 
that holds with the dew remains to be seen. It was two wickets each for Kuldeep and 
Chahal, two for Chahar as well, and five overs of bowling for Hardik Pandya that were 
the highlights for India. So too was Krunal's miserly spell. All in all, a pretty competitive
